description: This file defines the OpenAPI specification for the 'Services.Local.Bridge' API, including its endpoints, request/response schemas, and associated components. It describes the API operations for retrieving, setting, and resetting statistics of a WAN Bridge device, along with detailed response schemas and object models.

methods.name: Services.Local.Bridge.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the status and configuration parameters of the WAN Bridge.

methods.name: Services.Local.Bridge.ResetStatistics
methods.description: Resets the statistics counters of the WAN Bridge.

methods.name: Services.Local.Bridge.Set
methods.description: Modifies the status and configuration parameters of the WAN Bridge.
